coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: P11A
names: P11A -- traffic median (half-circle island near Mission Bay Circle)
record.summary: A grass, semicircular traffic median immediately east of the 'Mission Bay Circle' roundabout, west of the Parklab Gardens soccer field; a real, already-landscaped median island per satellite imagery, hand-traced with the property owner's guidance and fit to an idealized semicircle. OCII's own September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P11/11A' together among the parcels already managed by SF Recreation and Parks (not among the still-pending 'when built' parcels), consistent with it being complete by that date.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- owner-guided satellite trace, idealized to a fitted semicircle rather than left as a raw hand-traced outline. Not a surveyed footprint or GIS file from the project team. street_clip_exempt=true: this is a real traffic median, inherently adjacent to/overlapping the street right-of-way in DataSF's curb data at its crosswalk corner -- clipping it against the generic street buffer would cut a real, visible piece of the median, not a mispositioning artifact. Owner-approved exception.
notes.digitized_from: Hand-traced from satellite imagery, guided directly by the owner's own marked-up screenshot (their drawn outline extracted from the photo via ORB feature-matching/homography rather than re-estimated by eye), then fit to an idealized semicircle per the owner's description of the real shape.

milestones.text: Already part of RPD's managed open-space inventory as 'P11/11A' (not listed among the still-pending 'when built' parcels), per OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the Mission Bay CAC -- an upper bound on when this median was built, not its actual construction date

open_questions: No public source names this specific median island or gives its own construction date; the Sept 2023 OCII document only establishes it existed and was already RPD-managed by that date (grouped with P11), which is an upper bound, not a build date.

This record was previously only a weak ~33m proximity guess with no real source before the property owner drew its actual outline directly on a satellite screenshot (per this record's own digitization_method log); the P-number itself, and any name/operator, remain unconfirmed by any independent published source.
